title: Discount Schedule: Repair-Status Discount on the Rental Vehicle Coordination Self-Pay Day Rate
content:
**Schedule.** The repair-status discount on the self-pay charge of a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental follows the status of the insurance claim repair the rental is for: a repair on hold takes 15 percent; a repair authorized or in repair takes the class customer-pay discount percent (10 percent in every class); a repair in any other status takes zero. The self-pay day rate is the class partner daily rate reduced by the percent discounts that apply to it; where more than one applies, the percents are added together first and taken off the partner daily rate once.

## Records read

The status of the insurance claim repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs that the rental is for.

## Discount by repair status

| Status of the insurance claim repair | Repair-status discount |
|---|---|
| On hold | 15 percent |
| Authorized | 10 percent (the class customer-pay discount percent) |
| In repair | 10 percent (the class customer-pay discount percent) |
| Any other status | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Compact Rental (partner daily rate 42.99 USD) whose insurance claim repair is on hold, with no other percent discount on the day rate: a self-pay day rate of 42.99 USD reduced by 15 percent, 36.5415 USD.
- The same rental with the repair in repair: 42.99 USD reduced by 10 percent, 38.691 USD.
- The same repair on hold and another discount of 5 percent also on the day rate: 15 and 5 make 20 percent, taken off once, 34.392 USD.
- The repair showing repair complete: no repair-status discount.
